plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Collection of document processing suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF capabilities

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: Collection of example skills demonstrating various capabilities including skill creation, MCP building, visual design, algorithmic art, internal communications, web testing, artifact building, Slack GIFs, and theme styling

plugins.name: journal-skills
plugins.description: Dynamically loaded academic journal submission skills (195+ journals supported). Use ./tools/load-journal.sh to select your target journal.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Research-grounded skills for humanizing AI-flavored text and forensically auditing text for AI-generation signals (from harshaneel/humanize), plus an academic-writing adaptation for polishing research manuscripts

plugins.name: cnki-skills
plugins.description: Browser-driven CNKI (China National Knowledge Infrastructure) literature workflow: search, filter, parse results, page through, read paper detail, browse journals, download PDFs, and export citations, coordinated by a cnki-researcher agent (from longkou1988/cnki-skills). Requires a browser connector (e.g. Chrome DevTools MCP) and the user's own authorized/institutional CNKI access; does not bypass login, CAPTCHA, or paywalls.
